svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-senior-technical-flight-officer-bullion","units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,32,100],"name":"Technical Flight Officer bullion grade insignia, mess dress shoulder board","size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same shape and size as the embroidered form rank-senior-technical-flight-officer-thread (0.32 x 1 in): CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-3 says only that the grade on the boards is metal bullion and gives no size. Male boards 5 1/2 x 2 1/4 in, female 4 1/2 x 2 in.","provenance":"recoloured from rank-senior-technical-flight-officer-thread: bullion silver (2d Lt and Major gold, others silver, matching the metal and thread forms); bullion texture drawn as a diagonal line pattern","colours":{"bullion":"#c6cbd1","bullion_line":"#8f969e","bullion_edge":"#7d848c"},"anchors":{"top_center":[16,0],"bottom_center":[16,100],"center":[16,50],"left_edge":[0,50],"right_edge":[32,50],"insignia_center":[16,50],"rank_slot_center":[16,50],"mount_center":[16,50]},"dimensions":{"form":"metal bullion grade insignia (mess dress shoulder board)","insignia_w_in":0.32,"insignia_h_in":1,"bar_count":1,"bar_length_in":1,"bar_width_in":0.32,"gap_in":0,"long_end":"vertical (OCP)","thread":"silver bullion","slot_fit":{"garment_rank_slot_in":{"along":1.5,"across":1.2},"piece_along_in":0.32,"piece_across_in":1,"scale_to_garment_slot":1,"note":"placement rule: leaf stem / stacked stars along the board, bars across, Colonel eagle wingspan along the board; scale < 1 only if the piece must stay inside the slot"}},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Men's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-male-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 5.5 x 2.25 in, 1/2 in dark blue lace each side (general officer boards: silver lace with 1/2 in blue lace), button at the peak (4.1.1.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."},{"uniform":"Women's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-female-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 4.5 x 2 in, 1/4 in blue lace each side on every grade (Fig A5-3), no button (4.1.2.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."}],"rank":{"grade":"Technical Flight Officer","abbrev":"TFO","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia","size_in":{"w":0.32,"h":1}}
